# ============================================================================
# iCIMS classic career portals, one public host per line (# starts a comment).
#
# PROVENANCE. The 2,053 hosts below come from the curated list at
# https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dtunkelang/job-search/main/slugs/icims_tenants.txt
# (downloaded 2026-07-28), whose own header states each host was verified live
# on 2026-06-25 by checking that
# https://{host}/jobs/search?pr=0&in_iframe=1 answers 200 with at least one
# iCIMS_JobCardItem. The employer names after "#" are that curator's
# annotations, kept verbatim; this project asserts nothing about them.
#
# WHAT THIS PROJECT MEASURED, 2026-07-28, from a container that reaches job
# boards. Nothing below is inferred from the upstream annotations.
#
#   page-0 probe, 321 distinct hosts (lines 1-300 and 340-360 of the list)
#     ok      306   200 with >= 1 iCIMS_JobCardItem
#     empty    12   200 with 0 cards (a real board that is not hiring, or the
#                   newer client-rendered "intro" template this adapter cannot
#                   read -- one sample cannot tell them apart, so they are NOT
#                   registered): careers-dickblick, careers-fnf, careers-cobank,
#                   careers-ctic, careers-harborstone, hrhcsacramento-hardrock,
#                   careers-wwfus, careers-blupeak, careers-ryder,
#                   successlink-boston, careers-roadrunner, careers-flatironcorp
#     404       3   careers-gsi, careers-amanet, careers-monarchblackhawk
#
#   full walk, 70 of the "ok" hosts, following <link rel="next"> to the end
#     70 boards, 778 HTTP requests, 19,922 distinct posting URLs
#
#   of those 70, seven turned out to be employers this project ALREADY crawls
#   through the Jibe adapter -- zero shared posting URLs but near-total shared
#   titles, which is a double count [internal.Dedupe] cannot collapse. They are
#   marked "LEFT TO JIBE" below with their measured comparison, and the Jibe
#   route is kept because it returns more postings at ~92 per request against
#   this platform's 24.5.
#
#     63 registered boards, 649 HTTP requests, 15,932 distinct posting URLs
#     = 24.5 postings per request
#
# Those 63 are the ones registered in internal/services/icims.go. Everything
# else here is staged and unprobed-by-this-project: registering a host nobody
# walked costs four retries a night if it is dead and an unbudgeted 3,800
# postings if it is jobs-selectmedicalcorp.
#
# 24.5 postings per request is the number that matters for sequencing.
# docs/research/ats-platform-survey.md ranked "iCIMS-classic" among the lanes
# that "will blow the time budget" and put any JSON-LD detail-walk platform
# "below 1" -- but that estimate was for the sitemap+JSON-LD route, one request
# per posting. The classic search route measures between Teamtailor (~14) and
# Pinpoint (~21) on that same ranking, and above Personio, ADP and Paylocity.
# It is not an expensive lane.
#
# PAGE SIZE IS PER TENANT, NOT PER PLATFORM. 154 of the 287 hosts that answered
# serve 20 cards a page and 53 serve 50. Nothing in the request controls it, so
# a board's cost is len(board)/its own page size and cannot be tuned.
#
# PROMOTION RULE, gated on content rather than status code. A host is
# promotable when https://{host}/jobs/search?pr=0&in_iframe=1 answers 200 and
# the page carries at least one <li class="iCIMS_JobCardItem"> holding an
# <a class="iCIMS_Anchor"> whose href is on the same host under /jobs/{id}/.
# A 200 with zero cards is NOT evidence either way; see "empty" above.
#
# OVERLAP WITH THE JIBE REGISTRY. iCIMS owns Jibe, and this project already
# crawls 251 Jibe boards, which are iCIMS's modern template. The two host
# spaces are disjoint by construction -- Jibe boards are on employer-owned
# vanity domains or *.jibeapply.com and answer /api/jobs, while these are
# *.icims.com and 404 that endpoint -- but an EMPLOYER can be on both. Checked
# 2026-07-28: none of the 69 company names derived from the 70 registered hosts
# collides with any name already in the registry, on Jibe or anywhere else.
# Costco, the employer docs/source-backlog.md names for iCIMS proper, is
# already covered by the Jibe adapter at careers.costco.com and is deliberately
# NOT registered here.
# ============================================================================
